observation.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
cd /tmp
# get CSRF token
TOKEN=$(curl -s --max-time 60 -c /tmp/cookies.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/agent_session/login | grep -o "name=\"authenticity_token\" value=\"[^\"]*\"" | head -1 | sed "s/.*value=\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/")
echo "TOKEN_LEN=${#TOKEN}"
curl -s -b /tmp/cookies.txt -c /tmp/cookies.txt --max-time 120 -o /dev/null -w "LOGIN_HTTP=%{http_code} REDIRECT=%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/agent_session/login --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "login=admin@example.com" --data-urlencode "password=test"
'
